description: K-CIA SQL Agent Golden Query Test Cases

queries.name: TopN 매출 추천
queries.question: 성수동 커피 전문점 매출 Top3 알려줘
queries.validation_sql: SELECT da.area_name, fs.sales_amt FROM fact_sales_area_qtr fs JOIN dim_area da ON fs.area_id = da.area_id JOIN dim_category dc ON fs.cat_id = dc.cat_id WHERE dc.service_name = '커피-음료' AND fs.qtr = '20251' ORDER BY fs.sales_amt DESC LIMIT 3

queries.name: QoQ 비교
queries.question: 성수동 카페 매출 전분기 대비 변화량 알려줘
queries.validation_sql: WITH curr AS (SELECT area_id, sales_amt FROM fact_sales_area_qtr fs JOIN dim_category dc ON fs.cat_id = dc.cat_id WHERE dc.service_name = '커피-음료' AND qtr = '20251'), prev AS (SELECT area_id, sales_amt FROM fact_sales_area_qtr fs JOIN dim_category dc ON fs.cat_id = dc.cat_id WHERE dc.service_name = '커피-음료' AND qtr = '20244') SELECT da.area_name, c.sales_amt AS curr_sales, p.sales_amt AS prev_sales, ROUND((c.sales_amt - p.sales_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(p.sales_amt, 0) * 100, 2) AS change_pct FROM curr c JOIN prev p ON c.area_id = p.area_id JOIN dim_area da ON c.area_id = da.area_id ORDER BY c.sales_amt DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: 적합도 점수 (창업 추천)
queries.question: 성수동에서 제과점 창업하기 좋은 상권 Top3 추천해줘
queries.validation_sql: SELECT da.area_name, fs.sales_amt, ff.flow_total, fst.store_cnt FROM fact_sales_area_qtr fs JOIN dim_area da ON fs.area_id = da.area_id JOIN dim_category dc ON fs.cat_id = dc.cat_id LEFT JOIN fact_flow_area_qtr ff ON fs.area_id = ff.area_id AND fs.qtr = ff.qtr LEFT JOIN fact_store_area_qtr fst ON fs.area_id = fst.area_id AND fs.qtr = fst.qtr AND fs.cat_id = fst.cat_id WHERE dc.service_name = '제과점' AND fs.qtr = '20251' ORDER BY fs.sales_amt DESC LIMIT 5
